data.text:
CAAP, itinanggi ang kumakalat na umano'y pagbagsak ng aircraft sa Palawan 

'The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) denies circulating reports regarding an alleged aircraft crash in Roxas, Palawan.

All flights operating within Palawan and its surrounding areas have been fully accounted for, with no incidents, emergencies, or distress calls reported.

The CAAP’s Philippine Aeronautical Rescue Coordination Center (PARCC), in coordination with air traffic control units, airline operators, and local authorities, has conducted thorough verification and confirms that no aircraft is missing or involved in any mishap.

The public is strongly urged to obtain information only from official sources and to refrain from disseminating unverified reports that may cause unnecessary alarm,' ayon sa CAAP. | RH 15 @JecelleRicafort, DZRH News
